All data got collected manually and therefore can include mistakes like false values or information. If you happen to notice one, please contact us! Some of the parameters are relatively hard to determine precisely and we obviously can't guarantee them to always be correct. As most of the data on timings got determined using frame counting on 60fps recordings, the general margin of error is 16.66ms. This is even more of an issue as some of the values listed in game turned out to be misleading or straight up wrong. (Example: Truth is listed as 15 RPM while it actually is 45 RPM). Even the slightest change in values or assumptions can cause significant movement among the rankings so judge the weapons with caution and common sense and don't blindly rely on this spreadsheet.
Some (exotic) weapon mechanics exceed what the formulas can handle and therefore got slightly simplified. Read more on those cases in the 'How-To-Use'-tab

The numbers in this spreadsheet require (almost) perfect conditions and execution in most cases. Consider them the theoretical ceiling. Ease-of-use is not a factor in this framework but will always be in praxis.

The scope of this spreadsheet was to make weapons more comparable by applying coherent and consistent measures and calculations. The modifiers allow for indidividual settings and the assumptions made regarding several parameters try to be as close to actual Raid Boss encounters as possible.
